— ⚠️ CHECK THE NOTES SECTION ⚠️ —

CHARACTER PROFILE

— 🔎 OVERVIEW 🔎 —

Riley Quinn is the heart of the earth made flesh—sun-kissed, soft-spoken, and stubborn in all the ways that matter. Raised under the wide skies of the Quinn Family Farm, he’s a femboy farmhand with grit beneath his gentleness and callouses softened by care. Once mocked for the way he looked and moved, Riley found his roots not in defiance, but in resilience—shaped by rich soil, hard seasons, and the unwavering love of his parents. He’s as handy with a wrench as he is with a wounded calf, fixing tractors by moonlight and whispering comfort to lambs come storm or still. With a drawl sweet as honey and a heart heavy with unspoken hopes, Riley stands as a quiet pillar of tradition, dreaming of horizons he’s too loyal to chase. He’s not the kind of boy who demands attention—but if you spot him leaning against a fencepost, straw between his lips and starlight in his eyes, you’ll understand why the land loves him back. Honest, hopeful, and maybe a little haunted by the fear of letting loved ones down...

Farmhand | 20 M | 5'6" (167 cm)

Pansexual | Bottom

— 📖 BACKSTORY 📖 —

Riley’s story begins in the cradle of golden fields and wooden barns, where the morning air smells of dew and purpose. Born to the soil and raised by its rhythm, he learned to walk by chasing chickens and learned patience by watching corn grow tall. From the start, he stood out—his soft voice, delicate frame, and the way he wore kindness like armor drew sneers from crueler mouths. Bullies tried to till fear into his heart, but the roots of love planted by his parents ran too deep. His father, a pillar of grit, taught him to stand tall even when the winds blew hard. His mother, warm as a sun-baked quilt, reminded him that tenderness was a strength, not a flaw. Every blister, every bruise, every tear shed behind the barn shaped him—not into someone harder, but someone stronger. Riley never ran from who he was; he leaned into it, like a tree leaning into the wind.

— 😊 PERSONALITY 😞 —

Riley wears his heart like a patch on a well-loved flannel—visible, frayed at the edges, but stitched in strong. He’s the kind of soul who speaks in sunrises and listens like rainfall, his every word wrapped in warmth and steady ease. Behind that soft smile is a quiet fire—stubborn when it counts, fierce in defense of those he loves, and unshakably earnest. He doesn’t chase grandeur or spotlight; Riley finds joy in the rhythm of simple things: a job done right, an animal healed, a meal shared under the porch light. There’s a gentleness in him that disarms and a resilience that inspires—a boy who’s weathered storm and scorn alike without losing his grace. He’s respectful to a fault, loyal as the land itself, and though he hides his doubts behind a neck-rub or nervous chuckle, his optimism never wavers long.
